added.description:
What You'll Do

We’re looking for an Assistant Director of Engineering to join our Digital Experience team within Asset Management. In this role, you’ll lead an engineering team responsible for building client-facing web experiences and digital tools that support some of our largest global institutional clients.

You’ll have the opportunity to

Set strategic direction: Partner with product, marketing, and business leaders to shape the digital experience strategy across client-facing platforms, delivering scalable web and portal solutions that support global Asset Management clients
Lead and inspire: Guide teams supporting public websites, secure client portals, and digital tools, driving high-quality delivery across multiple agile product teams and global regions
Translate vision into action: Bridge digital, engineering, and business priorities—ensuring seamless execution of initiatives that enhance how clients access investment insights, data, and tools
Drive alignment: Influence and align cross-functional partners across product families, enabling coordinated delivery of digital capabilities and client experiences at scale
Innovate for impact: Identify and advance new digital capabilities, including next-generation tools and AI-enabled experiences to improve client engagement, usability, and platform scalability
Build high-performing teams: Coach and develop engineering talent (both direct and matrixed), fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement across a global team
Stay future-focused: Monitor trends in digital experience, client expectations, and financial services technology to evolve our web and client platform ecosystem for long-term growth

Operating at the intersection of financial services and technology, Principal builds financial tools that help our customers live better lives. We take pride in being a purpose-led firm, motivated by our mission to make financial security accessible to all. Our mission, integrity, and customer focus have made us a trusted leader for more than 140 years.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree (preference in a computer science, technology, engineering or math-related field) or equivalent experience
8+ years of enterprise-level digital or technical experience, demonstrating progressive responsibility and impact
Formal people leadership experience, coaching talent, and building build a culture of accountability and collaboration
Strong background in digital experience, web platforms, or client-facing product delivery
Proven ability to influence across teams and leaders in a highly matrixed environment
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business stakeholders
Comfortable working in a global operating model across multiple regions and time zones

Skills That Will Help You Stand Out

4+ years of technology leadership managing and mentoring direct reports; proven ability to build strong teams and a culture of accountability
Asset Management domain experience
Proven experience in financial services, with the ability to navigate complex client, product, and regulatory environments
Experience leading technical direction of global or distributed teams
Strong understanding of UX/CX and delivering best-in-class client experiences
Experience building or scaling digital platforms, client portals, or authenticated user experiences
Exposure to AI or emerging technologies applied to digital experience or client platforms

Salary ranges below reflect targeted base salaries. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation for all roles will be based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Salary Range (Non-Exempt expressed as hourly; Exempt expressed as yearly)

$145000 - $185000 / year

Flexible Time Off (FTO) is provided to salaried (exempt) employees and provides the opportunity to take time away from the office with pay for vacation, personal or short-term illness. Employees don’t accrue a bank of time off under FTO and there is no set number of days provided.

Pension Eligible

Yes

Work Environments

This role offers an in-office and hybrid (blending at least three office days in a typical workweek) work arrangement in Des Moines, IA, Charlotte, NC, Raleigh, NC, Chicago, IL or New York, NY.

Our Engineering Culture

Through our product-driven Agile/Lean DevOps environment, we’ve fostered a culture of innovation and experimentation across our development teams. As a customer-focused organization, we work closely with our end users and product owners to understand and rapidly respond to emerging business needs.

Collaboration is embedded into everything we do – from the products we develop to the quality service we provide. We’re driven by the belief that diversity of thought, background, and perspective is critical to creating the best products and experiences for our customers.

added.title: Design Technology Director
added.description:
Design Technology Director AgeWave Solutions | Central Florida | Full-Time | In-Person

About the Role AgeWave Solutions is looking for a unique combination of CAD expert, problem solver, and software developer to join our growing architecture and structural engineering firm.
This is a full-time, in-person position based in Central Florida. This is not a remote or hybrid role. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
This is not a traditional drafting position, and it is not a traditional software development position.
We are looking for someone who understands how architectural and engineering drawings are actually produced—and who can identify repetitive processes, bottlenecks, quality-control opportunities, and manual tasks that can be improved through AutoCAD customization, programming, automation, and better systems.
Our team produces a significant volume of residential and commercial construction documents. We see a major opportunity to automate portions of drawing production, option management, plan checking, data entry, scheduling, and quality control.
The right person will help us design, build, and lead the implementation of those systems.

What You’ll Work On You will work directly with our leadership, CAD production, architecture, engineering, and software teams to improve how work moves through AgeWave.
Responsibilities may include:
Develop AutoCAD automation tools using AutoLISP, C#/.NET, Python, AutoCAD APIs, scripts, and related technologies.
Build and improve dynamic blocks, intelligent content, templates, standards, and automated drawing workflows.
Analyze repetitive drafting and production processes and determine what can be automated, streamlined, or eliminated.
Develop tools that can generate or modify drawings based on structured project information.
Help develop systems capable of managing large numbers of plan, elevation, structural, and option combinations.
Build automated tools that compare project requirements or contracts against drawings to identify discrepancies.
Develop automated QA/QC and plan-checking tools.
Extract information from existing CAD drawings and convert legacy drawing knowledge into structured, reusable data.
Automate repetitive drawing modifications, annotations, dimensions, schedules, blocks, attributes, and sheet information.
Connect AutoCAD workflows with external databases, APIs, our ERP, and other internal systems.
Develop batch-processing tools for large numbers of drawings.
Improve drawing consistency, accuracy, speed, and standardization.
Work directly with production staff to understand how they actually use CAD and develop practical solutions around real-world workflows.
Establish and help lead design technology standards, automation strategy, and implementation priorities across the company.
Document new systems and train team members on newly developed tools and workflows.
Evaluate emerging technologies, drawing review, and workflow automation, and determine where they can provide practical value.

What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate has an unusual combination of AEC production knowledge, CAD expertise, and software development ability.
Strong candidates may have experience with:
CAD / Design Technology: AutoCAD, AutoCAD Architecture, dynamic blocks, attributes, external references, drawing standards, templates, CAD data extraction, and high-volume drawing production.
Programming / Automation: AutoLISP, C#/.NET, Python, AutoCAD .NET API or ObjectARX concepts, APIs, databases, scripting, workflow automation, regression testing, and data processing.
AEC / Production: Architectural, structural, fabrication, residential, commercial, manufacturing, or construction-document production experience.
Leadership / Systems Thinking: The ability to evaluate existing processes, identify opportunities, prioritize technology initiatives, develop solutions, and successfully implement those solutions with production teams.
A degree in architecture, engineering, or computer science is not required. We care much more about demonstrated ability to understand a production problem and build a working solution that improves the business.

Position Requirements Must be able to work full-time, in person at our Central Florida office
.
This position is not available as a remote or hybrid role.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States
.
Strong hands-on AutoCAD experience is highly preferred.
Must be comfortable working directly with architects, engineers, CAD professionals, software developers, and company leadership.
Must be capable of taking an automation opportunity from idea → workflow analysis → development → testing → implementation → adoption
.

You May Be a Great Fit If... You find yourself looking at a repetitive 20-minute CAD task and thinking:
“Why are we doing this manually?”
You enjoy digging into an existing workflow, understanding why it works the way it does, and then figuring out how to make it faster, more reliable, and easier to scale.
You are equally comfortable talking with a drafter about dynamic blocks, discussing an engineering workflow, and opening an IDE to build the solution.
Most importantly, you don't just want to maintain existing CAD systems. You want to help build the next generation of how architecture and engineering production gets done.

added.title: Senior Manager, Analytics Engineering
added.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team at Toast is on a mission to deliver a trusted, scalable, and governed data foundation that empowers every team at Toast to make decisions with speed and confidence. As Toast scales and AI becomes central to its product and operational strategy, EDS serves as the engine behind that ambition, building the data infrastructure, governance frameworks, and data products that business functions across Toast depend on.

The Senior Manager, Analytics Engineering will lead the team responsible for our core Analytics layer in Toast's enterprise data warehouse and own the data architecture and modeling strategy that enables federated analytics teams across all enterprise data domains. This person will set direction for how Toast models, governs, and exposes data at scale, and will build and develop a team of analytics engineers capable of executing on that vision. The ideal candidate has high standards for their team's work and a track record of raising the bar across an organization. They bring deep expertise in enterprise data solutions, a point of view on where the semantic and analytics layers of a modern data platform should go, and the judgment to balance long-term architecture with near-term business needs. We are looking for a leader who can operate across ambiguity, align stakeholders across the company, and build a team and roadmap that enable all Toasters to make data-informed decisions.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

Own the strategy and roadmap for a hub & spoke data architecture, and drive alignment on it across domain teams
Lead the team that builds and maintains the core Analytics layer in our data warehouse, ensuring it meets the needs of the domain teams building on top of it
Set the vision for an AI-ready semantic layer that is extendable across business domains, and guide its execution
Build, manage, and develop a team of analytics engineers — hiring, coaching, and setting growth paths
Partner with senior business stakeholders, product leadership, and engineering leadership to align on data analytics priorities across the organization
Represent EDS's analytics strategy in cross-functional and leadership forums
Partner closely with data engineering leadership to ensure platform scalability and coherent architecture across teams
Provide technical and people leadership, mentorship, and career development to team members

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

8+ years experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, and/or Data Engineering roles
2+ years experience managing or formally leading a team of analytics or data engineers
5+ years experience developing data modeling strategies at scale
4+ years experience developing in dbt
Ability to understand the business needs behind data modeling decisions
Highly proficient in SQL, with a focus on query design and performance
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment
Thrives in a fast-paced environment and comfortable operating under ambiguity

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

Experience with Airflow
Experience with Sigma, Hex, and/or other BI dashboard tools
Experience in cloud-based data warehouses, specifically Snowflake
Experience with Python
Experience building or scaling a data/analytics engineering function
Experience in a SaaS or FinTech focused enterprise

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Few names in aerospace carry the engineering legacy of Rocketdyne. For more than 70 years, Rocketdyne technologies have helped power some of the most consequential missions in space exploration. More than 22,000 spacecraft engines have been delivered, over 500 upper-stage rockets have flown successfully, and Rocketdyne propulsion and power technologies have supported missions across our solar system.

Rocketdyne is independent again — and we have an opportunity to build on that heritage while creating what comes next.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to help lead that next chapter. This is not a role focused on maintaining an established engineering organization. It is an opportunity to help shape one. You will lead an engineering community of 350+ engineers across multiple businesses and locations, partnering directly with Rocketdyne's senior leadership team and President/CEO to define our technical direction, strengthen engineering execution, build critical capabilities and ensure we have the people, processes and technology required for the missions ahead.

The mandate is broad: protect the rigor that has defined Rocketdyne Engineering while challenging us to evolve where we need to.

Position Summary

As Senior Director of Engineering, you will have enterprise responsibility for engineering strategy, technical excellence and execution across Rocketdyne. You will help answer some of the most important questions facing our engineering organization: Where do we invest? What capabilities will our customers and missions require next? How do we accelerate innovation while maintaining the rigor required of mission-critical systems? What engineering practices should define the newly independent Rocketdyne? And how do we develop the next generation of technical leaders who will carry that work forward? You will translate those questions into action.

What Will Make You Successful Here

We are looking for an accomplished engineering leader, but experience alone will not define success in this role.

You should be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level — capable of discussing long-range technology and investment priorities with executive leadership and equally willing to get into the details when a program, proposal or technical challenge requires it.

You have led large, technically complex organizations and understand how to create alignment across disciplines, programs, and locations. You know how to balance innovation with engineering rigor and how to make thoughtful decisions when cost, schedule, technical performance, and mission requirements compete.

Just as importantly, you are energized by the opportunity to build.

Rocketdyne is entering a new chapter as an independent company. Not everything will already be defined. The right leader will see that not as a limitation, but as an opportunity to influence how we operate, what we prioritize and what kind of engineering organization we become.

Required Experience

20+ years of progressive engineering experience, with significant leadership responsibility in technically complex environments
Demonstrated success leading large, cross-functional and/or multi-site engineering organizations
Significant depth within one or more engineering disciplines such as aerospace engineering, design and analysis, avionics, systems engineering, materials, processes or component engineering

Strong technical and programmatic judgment with the ability to identify risk and drive decisions
Experience partnering with senior executives, customers and cross-functional business leaders
A track record of building strong engineering teams and developing technical and people leaders
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree welcomed
Experience with government or defense customers, EVMS, bid and proposal estimating, digital engineering, IRAD strategy and large-scale organizational transformation would be particularly valuable.

Preferred Additional Skills

Significant experience across one or more engineering disciplines including Aerospace Engineering, Design & Analysis, Avionics, and/or Systems, Materials, Process, or Component Engineering
Experience working with government and/or defense customers
Experience across the Aerospace Industry
Experience applying multiple B&P estimation methodologies (engineering, bottoms-up, Stim-To, Delphi, parametric, etc)
Deep experience with Earned Value management (EVMS), metrics, and data driven decisions
Experience in Digital Engineering concepts, methodologies, and tools

Demonstrated problem solving and technical/programmatic judgment
Demonstrated experience leading large teams with proven ability to quickly build rapport and establish trust with senior leaders, colleagues, and subordinates

Why Rocketdyne. Why Now.

There are established companies where the engineering model, organization and ways of working have already been defined.

This is different.

Rocketdyne has the heritage, technology, people and mission history of one of the most recognized names in aerospace — combined with the opportunity that comes from becoming an independent company again.

For the right engineering leader, that creates a rare opportunity: honor what made Rocketdyne exceptional, help determine what needs to change, and leave a meaningful imprint on what Rocketdyne Engineering becomes next.

If that sounds like the kind of challenge you have been looking for, we would like to talk.

About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Measures of Success

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

The Senior Manager, Engineering & Enterprise Architect serves as the organization's primary enterprise architect, providing enterprise-wide leadership for the design, integration, governance, and strategic direction of applications, infrastructure, data platforms, and development practices. This role establishes architecture standards, governance processes, and the Architecture Review Board (ARB), while serving as the key architecture decision-maker across on-premises and cloud environments. The role also leads a team of Integration/Productivity Platform Engineers and Data Engineers, ensuring technology solutions align with business objectives and long-term technology strategy. This is a player-coach role that combines direct enterprise architecture accountability with engineering leadership for a technical team.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

General

-      Serves as the organization's primary enterprise architect and maintains accountability for enterprise architecture across all technology domains.
-      Directly performs and leads enterprise architecture activities, including architecture strategy, standards, governance, and solution reviews, while managing engineering resources responsible for implementation and operational support.
-      Possesses broad and deep technical knowledge across enterprise platforms and can assess multiple solution options against business and technical criteria.
-      Provides architectural guidance, mentorship, and direction to other technical staff, including direct reports.
Application and Integration Architecture

-      Owns end-to-end application architecture across core platforms, including Oracle ERP, UKG, Azure-hosted applications, and associated middleware and integration layers.
-      Defines integration patterns, API standards, and data exchange protocols, with particular focus on Azure cloud-to-on-premises connectivity over Nutanix infrastructure.
-      Evaluates and recommends integration and middleware technologies to reduce point-to-point coupling and technical debt.
-      Partners with application owners and project teams to embed architecture standards into project delivery, from vendor selection through go-live.
-      Maintains current-state and target-state architecture documentation across the application and integration portfolio.
Infrastructure Architecture

-      Serves as the enterprise architecture authority for all infrastructure domains, including the on-premises Nutanix hyperconverged data center environment and the Azure cloud platform.
-      Defines and governs infrastructure architecture standards, including network topology, compute and storage patterns, identity and access management, and security boundaries.
-      Owns hybrid connectivity architecture between Azure and on-premises environments, ensuring designs meet requirements for performance, resilience, and security.
-      Establishes workload placement criteria and cloud adoption patterns that guide infrastructure decisions across the organization.
-      Partners with infrastructure teams on platform roadmaps, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle decisions for both Nutanix and Azure environments.
-      Ensures infrastructure architecture aligns with and enables the broader application, data, and development strategy.
Data and Analytics Architecture and Platform Ownership

-      Serves as architect and product owner for the Azure Synapse/Databricks data platform, owning the platform roadmap, vendor relationship, licensing, and governance model.
-      Defines data architecture standards, including data integration patterns, data modeling conventions, platform access controls, and data lifecycle management.
-      Ensures the data platform is architected to support current reporting and analytics needs while scaling to meet emerging AI and machine learning use cases.
-      Partners with data engineering, analytics, and business intelligence stakeholders to align platform capabilities with organizational data strategy.
-      Governs data flows between Oracle ERP, UKG, and the data platform, ensuring integration patterns are consistent, maintainable, and auditable.
Enterprise Architecture Governance and Standards

-      Establishes and operates an Architecture Review Board (ARB), defining scope, cadence, escalation paths, and decision rights.
-      Develops and maintains architecture principles, standards, and guardrails appropriate to the organization's scale and maturity.
-      Implements an architecture review process that supports project delivery without introducing unnecessary delay.
-      Builds relationships with business stakeholders to ensure architecture decisions reflect business priorities.
AI-Assisted Development Strategy and Internal Build Capability

-      Co-owns the organization's transition from a purchased-application model to an internal build capability, including defining build-versus-buy criteria and the boundary between internally-developed applications and systems of record.
-      Architects the standard approach for internally-built applications that extend or surface data from Oracle, UKG, and the Synapse/Databricks data platform.
-      Designs and governs the architecture for AI-assisted development practices, including the use of AI coding agents to support documentation, testing, and validation of deliverables against requirements.
-      Establishes architecture guardrails for internally-built applications, including security boundaries, data access controls, API design standards, and application lifecycle management.
-      Partners with the Director of IT Strategy and Business Solutions to support the evolution of Business Systems Analyst roles toward Product Owner/Developer responsibilities.
-      Evaluates and recommends tools supporting internal development, including hosting platforms, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and AI development assistants.
Team Leadership

-      Leads and develops a team of Integration/Productivity Platform Engineers and Data Engineers, ensuring engineering activities align with enterprise architecture standards and technology strategy.
-      Acts as the primary architecture mentor and subject matter expert for the organization, providing architecture direction across all technology initiatives.
-      Promotes a culture of documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team.
-      Serves as a technical mentor for team members transitioning into product ownership and internal development roles.

It is the responsibility of all employees to uphold the mission of the Amy’s Food Safety and Quality Policy.  This includes following all Food Safety and Sustainability programs and participating in all required training.

-      This position carries supervisory responsibility for 3-5 direct reports.
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

-      Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, plus 8 or more years of progressive IT experience, including at least 4 years in an enterprise or solution architecture role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
QUALIFICATIONS

Application and Integration Systems Knowledge

-      Demonstrated experience designing and governing application integration architectures in complex, multi-system environments.
-      Hands-on familiarity with Oracle ERP (Cloud or EBS), including data flows, integration points, and extensibility patterns.
-      Experience with UKG or comparable HCM platforms from an integration and data perspective is preferred.
Infrastructure Knowledge

-      Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including networking, identity, security, and platform services.

Position Purpose:

SRS Distribution, part of The Home Depot family of companies, is establishing Pricefx as its enterprise platform for price optimization, price management, cost management, quoting/CPQ, and price execution across business units, sales channels, and customer experiences. The platform will support critical workflows across Agility, CoSailor, Order Now, Roof Hub and Heritage eCommerce, commercial quoting, and other connected enterprise systems.

We are seeking a business-facing, execution-focused technology leader to serve as Pricing Application Technology Director. This role is accountable for the strategy, lifecycle, roadmap, delivery, investment planning, service health, risk, controls, licensing, vendor ecosystem, and operating model for enterprise pricing technology, with Pricefx as the core platform. The Director will partner closely with the Enterprise Pricing Product Owner, who owns business strategy, priorities, and outcomes, to translate commercial needs into scalable technology capabilities and executable delivery plans.

You will lead a centralized Pricing Technology team spanning solution architecture and platform engineering while working across Digital Commerce, Enterprise Applications, ERP, Data Engineering, API Integration, Cybersecurity, IAM, and other technology teams. A core expectation is that SRS retains internal ownership of platform strategy, architecture, configuration, controls, and critical technology decisions while using Pricefx for the underlying SaaS platform and managed-services partners for scalable L1/L2 support and routine operations.

Enterprise Strategy & Business Partnership

Own and communicate the multi-year enterprise pricing technology strategy and roadmap across price optimization, price and cost management, quoting/CPQ, price execution, real-time pricing, and related commercial capabilities.
Serve as the senior Technology partner to pricing, commercial, product, sales, finance, and business leaders, connecting business priorities to technology strategy, investment decisions, sequencing, and measurable outcomes.
Ensure Pricefx and connected applications evolve as an integrated enterprise capability rather than a collection of business-unit or channel-specific solutions.
Partner with Digital Commerce, Enterprise Applications, ERP, and vertical technology leaders to align pricing, quoting, customer-facing experiences, and real-time pricing capabilities to a common architecture and roadmap.
Establish outcome and operational measures for delivery predictability, platform reliability, release quality, incident performance, and business enablement; use them to drive transparent operating reviews.

Platform Lifecycle, Delivery & Operations

Own the Pricefx platform lifecycle from capability planning and implementation through releases, upgrades, operations, optimization, and eventual retirement or replacement decisions.
Be accountable for delivery, budget and investment planning, resource capacity, licensing, service health, risk, vendor performance, and total cost of ownership.

Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.
